cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

mechanism: A grades a former pupil bargaining skill while pricing every helpful and emotional part of their exchange.
confusable: Not ordinary negotiation about a tool alone: the teacher treats friendship acknowledgment as a tradable term too.
comparison: Tool loan with sentimental discount versus apology exchanged for holiday time and real forgiveness.
seedUse: Keep D22 ladder/rides/payment/friendship structure; S05 negotiation teaching becomes the method of counteroffers.
